coverageNote: Includes the eight usable bilingual Paper 1 PDFs in the official NTA archive for 2, 3, 4, 7 and 8 April 2025. The official 4 April Shift 1 PDF was excluded because complete rendering showed that many pages omit the question text and options. No third-party substitute is included.
verification: Each included live NTA PDF was checked for Paper 1 identity, date, shift, English and Hindi question versions, 75 unique questions, all Mathematics, Physics and Chemistry sections, absence of an answer key, page count, byte length, SHA-256 and complete visual rendering.
